item.title: By: carl
item.dc:creator: carl
item.description:
Luke has been trying to nudge me to switch from posting on the forum to blogging for ages. I imagine one advantage is that this will 'free up' the forum.
I suppose the idea here is that the Blog part is where I toss out my observations. Anyone who wishes can comment there of course, but also perhaps feel freer to toss out something of their own on the forum. A forum allows for a more even exchange of ideas (more conducive to discussion), whereas a blog is heavily weighted towards the blogger's (my) thoughts.
So, that's how it looks to me today anyway. I look at this whole endeavor as an experiment. That way, what ever happens, happens for the best. Hmm, that's not a bad way to look at life in general. I've always thought that if Nature had a thinking mind, it would say, "Relax, I'm just experimenting".

item.title: By: Lynn C.
item.dc:creator: Lynn C.
item.description:
Give up thinking? When we give up breathing. Hearts gotta beat, lungs gotta breathe, brains gotta think.
My thoughts kind of go around in circles and then shoot off on tangents, so reading the coherent thoughts written here is a nice change of pace for me.
I haven't written much because I haven't got much to say. That's pretty nice in a physical reality, but on the Internet makes one kind of invisible!
